correctness.rationale: A four-vector Parseval Gram matrix is a rank-two orthogonal projection. Matching off-diagonal signs converts total coherence to \(\max_S\operatorname{tr}(SP)\), and Ky Fan reduces the optimization to the sum of the two largest eigenvalues of the 64 Seidel sign matrices. Switching normal form gives spectra \({3,-1,-1,-1}\), \({1,1,1,-3}\), or \({\sqrt5,1,-1,-\sqrt5}\), so the optimum is \(1+\sqrt5\). The eigengap yields the unique maximizing projection within the middle switching class. The frozen exact-arithmetic verifier was read and confirms the switching counts and projection identities.
